description_en: Set to 1 to force strikethrough rendering for ~~text~~ in Claude's responses when your terminal supports it but is not auto-detected, such as over SSH without TERM_PROGRAM forwarded. Without this, undetected terminals show the literal ~~ markers instead of rendering the text as strikethrough. Requires Claude Code v2.1.186 or later
description_ja: SSH経由などで端末の種類が自動認識されない場合に、Claudeの応答内の打ち消し線を強制的にレンダリングするように設定します。
